shadowSentences: I love reading books at night.
The sun sets beautifully over the ocean.
Cooking is one of my favorite hobbies.
I often go for walks in the park.
Traveling to new places excites me a lot.
My family enjoys playing board games together.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
I like to try different kinds of cuisine from around the world.
Volunteering at the local shelter has been very rewarding.
Exploring nature trails gives me a sense of peace and adventure.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you share a personal experience that made you more aware of environmental issues?
Q2: What do you think are some common challenges people face when trying to be environmentally friendly?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to protect the environment?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who wants to live a more eco-friendly lifestyle?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about time management.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a time when you struggled with managing your time effectively?
Q2: What are some difficulties you encounter when trying to stick to a schedule?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of time management in daily life?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone looking to improve their time management skills?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What is your personal experience with maintaining a regular exercise routine?
Q2: What obstacles do you think people face when trying to stay active?
Q3: How do you view the role of exercise in a healthy lifestyle?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone who wants to start exercising regularly?
